label: H.R. 8036
title: Interagency Coordination in Export Controls Act of 2026

items.snippet: It also directs the Department of State to evaluate China's military-civil fusion strategy (a national strategy to eliminate barriers between China's civilian commercial sector and its military and defense industrial sectors).
Specifically, the bill authorizes the State Department and the Departments of Defense and Energy to propose new rules or amendments to existing rules under the Export Administration Regulations.
Specifically, the bill authorizes the State Department and the Departments of Defense and Energy to propose new rules or amendments to existing rules under the Export Administration Regulations.
These departments may submit proposals directly to the Export Administration Review Board (EARB), which reviews applications for export licenses.

items.item: Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Securities (BIS)
items.snippet: The Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Securities (BIS) must initiate the rulemaking process for each proposal accepted by a simple majority vote of the EARB. BIS…
The State Department must report to Congress on the activities required by the bill.

B001307.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
B001307.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
B001307.note: None of this member's itemized donors work in the industries of this bill's lobbying clients.
